note: Each entry paraphrases the named reporting in the author's words. Supplied PSN descriptions are reproduced separately as sources. An explicit 'author inference' label denotes interpretation or a planning suggestion rather than a verified unlock rule.

1.summary: A launch-list platinum with one playthrough, no difficulty requirement and no online trophies.
steps: Finish the story while keeping manual saves at chapter boundaries; published reporting says free roam remains available, but mission replay does not.
Clear every other single-player requirement, then use the roadmap's final audit to fill the remaining activity, collectible and 100% entries.
Avoid cheats during the platinum run: the cited everytrophy guide says they disable trophies and saving.
The platinum unlocks when the other 54 trophies are complete; it has no separate activity grind.
sources: Official PSN description: Congratulations! You're a Leonida Legend.
everytrophy.com — Grand Theft Auto VI: full platinum guide and all 55 trophies: two golds, six silvers, 46 bronzes and no online or DLC trophies.
GTA6 Field Guide — GTA 6 trophy list: PS5 list totals 55 trophies and 1,350 points.

2.summary: The opening story marker and a good time to set up long-term progress tracking.
steps: Begin the story and play through the Chapter 1 mission Gone Fishing.
Complete the mission normally; no optional medal or performance condition is reported.
Author inference: use the opening free-roam stretches to scan new vehicles and do unfamiliar activities so the later 100-vehicle and activity-type targets accumulate naturally.
sources: Official PSN description: Complete Gone Fishing.
everytrophy.com — GTA VI full platinum guide: Gone Fishing is an early Chapter 1 mission and the trophy is not missable.

3.summary: Finish Chapter 1, but do not instantly skip its early-Chapter 2 trophy trigger.
steps: Complete the missions that finish Chapter 1.
If the trophy does not unlock immediately, continue into What's in the Bag?, the first Chapter 2 mission; everytrophy reports the unlock there.

Before leaving Chapter 1, follow Lucia to Jason's balcony and accept the morning meditation after Down to Earth. Its requirement for the meditation trophy is not confirmed, so treat it as a precaution.
sources: Official PSN description: Complete Chapter 1.
everytrophy.com — GTA VI full platinum guide: chapter unlock timing and the unobtainable-after-Chapter 1 balcony meditation.
GTA6 Field Guide — GTA 6 trophies and achievements roadmap: advises chapter manual saves and flags Positive Mental Attitude as potentially missable.

4.summary: Close Chapter 2 and continue into Chapter 3 for the unlock, then use the larger free-roam sandbox for partner and collectible work.
steps: Play the Chapter 2 story missions through the chapter's conclusion.
Complete Welcome to Vice City, the first Chapter 3 mission; everytrophy reports that this is where the Chapter 2 trophy pops.
After Coffee Break, pair Jason and Lucia for roaming: the same guide identifies this mission as opening shared free-roam play needed by partner activities.
sources: Official PSN description: Complete Chapter 2.
everytrophy.com — GTA VI full platinum guide: chapter timing and the Coffee Break partner-free-roam unlock.

Continue through Ocean Beach and Another Life at the start of Chapter 4; the reported trophy trigger comes after those first two missions.

Author inference: before the heaviest collectible travel, clear the named Chapter 3 jobs for the Key Cloner, Snap Gun and Dye Pack Jammer so later robbery and vehicle targets can be handled without replaying unavailable missions.

Finish That's Where The Money Is…, the optional Chapter 4 mission that everytrophy says opens bank vault robberies.
Complete Chapter 4 to earn this story trophy, then make a manual save before proceeding into the final chapter.

Save separately around the finale if you want a chapter reference, because everytrophy reports no mission replay.
Return to free roam after the credits and use the roadmap stages for the remaining side jobs, collectibles and 100% checklist.

14.summary: The central gold completion target; many requirements overlap with other trophies but several ask for deeper totals.
